processNotes: Tooling, process order and times are inferred demo estimates. The historical routing records final assembly at work center 60; it does not establish this complete routing.
The demonstration receives the frame and other manufactured subassemblies already made. It does not infer their internal manufacturing processes or unspecified hardware.
Quantities are per representative bicycle and retain the source units. The pedal entry is 1 EA; the source does not establish a pair.
variantNotes: All four listed variants are Yellow, in sizes 40, 42, 44 and 48. The primary recipe uses the size 40 frame, product 833 (FR-R72Y-40).

For size 42, product 974 uses frame 834 (FR-R72Y-42); for size 44, product 975 uses frame 835 (FR-R72Y-44); for size 48, product 976 uses frame 836 (FR-R72Y-48). Do not substitute the size 40 frame for these variants.
The listed direct components other than the frame, including both wheels, are shared across the four variants at the same quantities. No other color variant is supplied.

100271.title: Representative bicycle assembly overview
guidance: Support 1 EA ML Road Frame-W - Yellow, 40 (Product Number FR-R72Y-40) in an assumed bicycle assembly stand. The overview in 100271 shows the principal component relationships.

Fit 1 EA ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451) at the frame's steering area, then fit 1 EA ML Road Handlebars (Product Number HB-R720). The frame subassembly includes its fork; the source does not specify headset internal assembly order.
Fit 1 EA ML Road Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-R430) to the frame and check its visible alignment.
Fit 1 EA ML Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-8107) at the frame's lower junction, followed by 1 EA ML Crankset (Product Number CS-6583) and 1 EA ML Road Pedal (Product Number PD-R563).
Fit 1 EA ML Road Front Wheel (Product Number FW-R762) at the fork and 1 EA ML Road Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-R762) at the rear of the frame.
